author: Apple Explained
description: If you’re a longtime iPhone user, you’re probably familiar with Apple’s trade-in program. Where giving Apple your old phone earns you a discount on a new one. Apple might say it’s being “recycled” or “given a second life,” but they never explain what that actually means. Like where your phone goes, or if someone’s making money off it. Apple’s trade‑in program looks like a simple discount, but behind the scenes it’s a big, global business. There are companies you’ve probably never heard of likely taking apart your old phone, reselling it, and feeding it into a second‑hand market that Apple almost never talks about. So let's take a peak inside Apple’s secretive trade-in business and find out how it really works.
title: Inside Apple's Secretive Trade-In Program
